design: rolling pre-registration: each cohort file registers pools that pass the mechanical universe rule at its registered_at; each cohort is scored only on bars after its own registered_at; results pool over cohorts (a token already in an earlier cohort is not re-added).
hypothesis: Short-term mean reversion in established pump.fun memecoins on PumpSwap: buying after a >5% drop over 1 hour and holding 4 hours beats random entries in the same pools, net of costs.

costs.impact: size / (liquidity_usd / 2) per side, liquidity as registered
costs.note: PumpSwap charges ~0.30%/side (LP + protocol + creator); 0.50% leaves room for routing and priority fees

universe_rule: GeckoTerminal solana dex 'pumpswap' pools by 24h volume, pages 1-10; SOL-quoted; base not SOL/stable/LST; one pool per token (the busiest); liquidity >= $30k; 24h volume >= $100k; age >= 1 day.

evaluation.period: each cohort from its registered_at; score when the pooled data reaches >= 200 trades or 21 days after the first cohort, whichever comes first
evaluation.data: 5-minute OHLCV (USD) from GeckoTerminal for every registered pool, including pools that lost liquidity or died (their history stays available)
evaluation.primary: mean of (trade net return - mean net return of entering the same pool at every bar of the period with the same hold), over all trades; 90% CI by pool bootstrap
evaluation.success: primary excess > 0 with the 90% CI above 0, AND mean net return per trade > 0

history: v1 (mixed volume-ranked universe) and v2 (PumpSwap, with a filter bug) were superseded before any out-of-sample data existed; the rule and costs were fixed from v1's in-sample study and have not changed.
